\section{Rotation Design}
The trial has run since 2017 on twelve conventionally tilled plots,
each 0.4 hectares, arranged in a randomised complete-block design
with four replicates per phase of the rotation.
Nitrogen was sidedressed according to soil-test recommendations,
and all other operations followed district practice.

\section{Measurements}
Grain yield was determined by combine harvest of the central
six rows of each plot and adjusted to 13 percent moisture.
Standard errors are plot-level values pooled across replicates.
